'''Callonia spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] located on [[Callonia]] in the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]] stole the [[GX1 short hauler/Legends|GX1 Short Hauler]] ''[[Long Shot]]'' from Callonia spaceport. The [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was originally intended to function as a [[Yacht/Legends|pleasure yacht]] for an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Unidentified Imperial admiral (Fakir sector)|admiral]].<ref name="SWCP" />
